test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution enshrines the Right against Exploitation?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Article 23__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Articles 23-24 of the Indian Constitution cover the** fundamental right against exploitation.**
 
• Article 23 prohibits human beings and other similar forms of forced labour.
 
 
• Nothing in article 23 shall prevent the State from imposing compulsory service for a public purpose, and in imposing such service the State shall not make any discrimination on grounds only of religion, race, caste or class or any of them.
 
 
 
• Article 24 prohibits the employment of children below the age of 14 years in any factory, mine, or other hazardous activities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Article 14 says that all persons are equal before the law and entitled to equal protection of the law.
 
• Article 18 abolishes titles except military and academic.
 
• Article 19 guarantees six fundamental freedoms to all citizens.
 
• Article 21** ****provides the protection of life and personal liberty.**
 
• **Article 22 provides protection against arbitrary arrest and detention.**
 
• **Article 25 provides freedom to practice and propagate any religion**
 
• Article 29 provides the protection of the interests of minorities.
 
• Article 30 provides the right of minorities to establish and administer educational institutes.
